git add hammerspoon/init.lua tests/test_init.lua README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md install.sh setup.sh && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Remove dead features; switch the trigger to fn + left Control

Deletes subsystems that were either never reachable or no longer wanted:

- silence auto-stop: checkSilence() was never called and silenceTimer never
  created, so the constants and the per-chunk bookkeeping were pure ballast
- LLM refinement via Ollama, along with the cached reachability probe, the
  menu-bar toggle and tests/test_refine.sh
- preferred languages: read, defaulted and displayed, but the retry logic that
  consumed them was removed long ago, so it could not affect transcription
- undo tracking: lastInsertedText was written and never read; there is no hotkey
- the "Preferred" and "Settings..." menu items (one inert, one only able to open
  an overlay that says to use the menu bar)
- the _whisper global, whose `recording` field never left its initial value

The trigger moves from right Command to fn + left Control, which makes it a
modifier *combo* and adds two failure modes worth pinning down:

- matching with `flags & mask > 0` would fire on either half, so plain Control
  would start a recording on every Ctrl-C. triggerPressed() requires every bit.
- the release poller compared generic modifier names ("ctrl"), which cannot tell
  left Control from right Control. triggerHeld() re-reads the raw device flags
  through the same mask, so both halves are checked the same way in both paths.

Tests: the meeting-mode guard generalises into a table of deleted subsystems, and
a new `trigger` group lifts triggerPressed/triggerHeld out of the source and runs
them against the configured mask — full combo fires, neither half does, the
right-hand twin does not, releasing either half reads as released. Verified each
new guard fails on a one-line mutation of the current file. 69 checks pass.

Docs: README described a streaming pipeline (streamCheckAndDispatch,
splitAtSilence, pipelineFinalize, tiny-model partials) that does not exist in
init.lua; that section, the auto-stop section and the refinement section are gone.
install.sh no longer downloads the tiny model for the preview that never shipped.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -1
